runtime_evidence.note: Actual link map includes libc, libdlmalloc, compiler_rt stack_ops; generated JS runtime covered by complete Emscripten LICENSE including third-party text. C++ libraries generated in cache but no linked members observed; not claimed as linked.
runtime_evidence.scope: New link map was compared to the inherited reviewed runtime/source mapping; all 94 members match. Inherited codec/distribution acceptance is historical and is not this build's acceptance.

limits: Fresh Node tests against actual new ABI and bundles; browser/native full application acceptance is separate.
Inherited libwebp/SDK caches have fixed original source/build provenance; no old codec or distribution test is counted as new acceptance.
Allocation fault injection measures caller-visible ownership, not arbitrary true OOM or every libwebp internal allocation.
Direct Node CJS require has the same PlayCanvas interop limitation as the official 3.10.2 package; CJS codec/worker tests use actual PlayCanvas ESM exports as its external.
